decision: explicit mission-instance evidence with offline DAG validation
problem: run/request/mutation/idempotency identities can be fresh while durable mission ids or dependency edges still alias state from a previous qualification run

reviews.preferred: emit mission ids and dependency edges from the coordinator submit response and reject cross-run mission-id or graph-instance reuse
reviews.reason: proves actual durable mission instances are fresh while allowing the same logical orchestration template to repeat
rejects external dependency references, duplicate/self edges, duplicate ids, and dependency cycles before evidence can influence readiness
adds no qrexec round trips, no daemon or database, O(missions + edges) local work, and does not change MissionQueue/coordinator mutation semantics

alternatives.approach: infer graph independence from request and idempotency keys
alternatives.rejected: does not prove the coordinator returned fresh durable mission ids or same-run dependency references
hides replay/recovery defects and weakens the qualification objective
higher migration and regression surface before evidence shows a production identity collision

required: submit emits mission_graph_instance from real response missions
cross-run durable graph-instance reuse blocks readiness
same logical DAG with fresh mission ids remains allowed

lessons: logical DAG equality is not a failure; durable instance reuse is
qualification evidence should come from coordinator responses rather than synthetic identifiers
identity independence must be checked at transport, mutation, idempotency, and mission-instance layers
